jobs.prompt:
chore(cpp): final branch of the native C++ gateway port (residual fixes, full qualification, release notes)

CONTEXT (you have no other context than this prompt and the repository)
You start from branch `agent-jobs/cppgw-gemini-merge-20261119-44556239421-1` of ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi. It contains ONLY the native C++20 gateway (`cpp/gateway/`), `static/` and tooling; 453 test binaries and 5,258 cases pass in release and under sanitizers, and the paired conformance suite matches current production except two known shared validation failures. This job produces the FINAL branch of the port: the owner will merge it and later deploy from it. Your branch becomes a pull request; your final message is its body and is what the owner reads to decide: plain language, short sections (what this branch is; what changed since the TypeScript gateway in user-visible terms; how to build, test, package; how to run it as a service; security posture and opt-in switches; what is verified and how; known gaps).

OWNER POLICY (binding): functional behaviour must match production except deliberate deviations recorded in `cpp/gateway/docs/DEVIATIONS-FROM-BUN.md`; security must never get weaker; less first-party code is preferred.

GENERAL RULES
- The runner holds a model gateway token: never print it or write any credential to a file. Run tests with an empty `HOME`, a fresh `TMPDIR` and no provider variables. No real provider traffic: use local mocks only.
- Edit only `cpp/gateway/**` and `static/**`. Do not delete or weaken tests.
- Model connections can drop: create your report file in the first minutes and commit small steps often (the tree must build at each commit). Leave no build output, binaries or downloads in the checkout.
- Report file: `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/<job id>.md`: what you did, exact commands, real counts and measurements, what is unfinished, defects found outside your paths (report, do not fix). End your final message with the same summary.

YOUR MACHINE: GitHub-hosted Linux ARM64 runner (Ubuntu 24.04, 4 CPUs, 16 GB, sudo, network). Its packages are too old for this tree: install Clang 21 or newer from apt.llvm.org (or GCC 14+), build Boost 1.92.0 `json` and `container` static libraries from the official source archive in a temp directory (the tree needs Boost >= 1.86), install OpenSSL 3, zlib, ICU, brotli, zstd development packages and build SQLite 3.54.0 as `cpp/gateway/docs/CI.md` describes. Bun 1.4.0 may be installed when you need to run the TypeScript.


HARD WORKING RULE: your process can be restarted without warning and then knows only what is committed. Commit after each step; report `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/cppgw-final-20261119.md` updated in the same commits. After a restart read the report and `git log` first.

TASK
1. `git fetch origin agent-jobs/cppgw-residuals-1-20261119-44477130790-1` and merge it with an ordinary merge commit (a trial merge shows no conflicts). It has three fix commits. Keep two: `b58afd3d1` (oversized request fields validated before library calls) and `f90d511bf` (SSE bodies cancelled when response headers are rejected). REVERT the third with `git revert d35a8a8bbc9a986bded5bba2d9c0f0f1a11c4ea1` (it rejected unknown chat roles and unknown Responses tool types with hard-coded allowlists; the owner's decision is parity with production, which forwards them): after the revert, `src/chat/envelope.cpp` and `src/responses_request.cpp` must keep the oversized-`model` length checks if those came from `b58afd3d1` (re-add them if the revert removed them) but contain no role or tool-type allowlist; the conformance cases `chat-invalid-role` and `responses-invalid-tool-type` are again recorded as the two known shared failures; `docs/DEVIATIONS-FROM-BUN.md` no longer lists that deviation; that commit's unit tests for the allowlists are removed with it while every other test stays.
2. Consistency sweep of documents against the code as it is now (do not trust older reports): `cpp/gateway/README.md`, root `README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/RUNTIME.md`, `docs/RELEASES.md`, `docs/SECURITY-LIMITS.md`, `docs/DEVIATIONS-FROM-BUN.md`, `docs/CONFORMANCE.md`, `docs/MACOS.md`, `docs/RASPBERRY-PI.md`: test totals, library list and versions, environment switches (`UOS_GATEWAY_ALLOW_REDUCED_CONFINEMENT`, `UOS_GATEWAY_ENABLE_ANTIGRAVITY`, any other `UOS_GATEWAY_*` read by the code: grep for them and document each one in ONE table in `docs/RUNTIME.md` with default and effect), the service unit requirement (`EnvironmentFile=`, no implicit `.env`), limits. Add `cpp/gateway/docs/CUTOVER.md`: a checklist for the owner to replace the TypeScript service with this one on an Arch Linux ARM host and to roll back (build or download the package, verify checksum, install side by side on another port, point at a COPY of the data first, health checks to run, switch, rollback steps; it must say which steps touch live data and that the stored-data format is shared with the TypeScript gateway only as far as the KV tests prove: cite them). Use what `docs/SIDE-BY-SIDE.md` and `cpp/gateway/ops/` already contain rather than inventing procedures; where a step cannot be verified on your runner, mark it UNVERIFIED.
3. Full qualification on the final tree: `python3 cpp/gateway/tools/links.py --check`; all four release shards and all four sanitizer shards; the regex, `kv_jsc`, `json`, `http_request`, `url` fuzz targets for 5 minutes each with the workflow's own command; the portable Linux ARM64 package build and its Debian 12/13 verifier (`cpp/gateway/packaging/portable/build.sh`, `verify.sh`); the paired conformance gate per `cpp/gateway/conformance/README.md` against the pinned production commit (exactly the two known shared failures); a side-by-side smoke per `docs/SIDE-BY-SIDE.md` if its harness runs on your runner; `actionlint`; first-party production line count (state how it is counted) and the tracked-file count. Record every number with its command.

DONE WHEN
Step 1 is exactly as described, the documents agree with the code, every check in step 3 passes or is listed with its failure and diagnosis, and the final message is as specified.
